insights.one_liner: Dahua Technology Benelux is the Zoetermeer office of a global video surveillance and AIoT company; it sponsors visas and offers a supply chain internship without Dutch.

culture.text: A small local office of about 34 people, mainly in sales, business development, IT and operations.
Staff often studied business, international business or logistics, at schools such as Wittenborg, HAN and Saxion.
Its one open job here is an operations and supply chain internship in Zoetermeer.

open.text: Dahua Europe B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Dahua calls itself the world's second-largest video surveillance equipment supplier in 2022, active in over 180 countries.
